quarterly_data.signal: Capacity project timetable (2025 annual report, company plan): the Dongguan intelligent computing center high-multilayer high-density interconnect board project is to enter formal production and its capacity ramp in 2026, and its phase 2, planned and pushed ahead early during 2025, is expected to be put into use in Q2 2026; the Ji'an intelligent manufacturing high-layer-count computing board project (two stages of 35 ten-thousand square metres a year each) is expected to start trial production of its first stage in H2 2026. The company says it will push hard to raise output and expand capacity in 2026 to meet compute-sector capacity demand.
